question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total rebalance amount and total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %), with average goal shortfall counting against the score. Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1 (use 1 minus the normalised value for average goal shortfall), and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) g_short FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 rb.r_amt AS rebalance_amount,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 g.g_short AS goal_shortfall
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND g.g_short IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(rebalance_amount) mn_1, MAX(rebalance_amount) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(goal_shortfall) mn_3, MAX(goal_shortfall) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (rebalance_amount-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (1-(goal_shortfall-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0)))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.rebalance_amount,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.goal_shortfall,2) AS goal_shortfall
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: What was the total net cash flow during calendar year 2024 for investors who hold at least one position with investment type 'Gold'?
